hygiene: The load generators are killed by a bash trap on EXIT and the machine was confirmed back to idle with the target test green afterwards. windows-desk lost twelve runs to a background harness that survived its own completion notice.
lever: CPU contention. records/issue34-fanout-contention-macos.jsonl establishes the fan-out test is contention sensitive, so contention is the lever this bench has.
means: This bench CAN fail the assertion. That converts the #57 null from one experiment short into a calibrated one: the protocol detects a failure of this assertion on this host when the machine is loaded, and detects nothing at idle across 20 runs at two commits. So 0 of 10 at 7c0bba2 is a null from an instrument known to be able to fire.
not_claimed: That the contention failure and the 7c0bba2 failure are the same defect. They are the same ASSERTION failing. Nothing here identifies the mechanism, and treating them as one would be the pooling error #44 already paid for.
second_finding: Contention alone breaks this assertion on Linux. windows-desk blamed contention first, then bisected cleanly to 7c0bba2 with the load held constant, and set contention aside - correctly for THEIR result. Both can be true: the assertion is reachable by at least two routes, and any measurement of it has to hold the machine's load fixed or it is measuring the wrong one.
